Dear Sir/ Madam, 
 
Sub: Intimation regarding Institutional Investors & Analyst Meet 2026 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and  
Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we would like to inform that Titan Company Limited 
will hold its “Institutional Investors & Analyst Meet 2026” for Institutional Investors & 
Institutional Research Analysts on Thursday, 4th June 2026. 
 
The presentation(s) of the aforesaid event will be submitted to the Stock Exchanges and hosted on  
the Company's website. 
 
This is for your information and record. 
 
Yours truly,

Bengaluru, India – 25th May 2026 
 
Titan Company Limited will hold its Institutional Investors and Analysts Meet in Mumbai on 
Thursday, 4th June 2026. The conference will begin at 8:30 AM IST and is expected to conclude by 
2:00 PM IST on the same day. 
 
The aforesaid event is open to Institutional Investors and Institutional Research Analysts. The 
admission to the event is based on prior registration and approval and at the sole discretion of the 
Company. 
 
A copy of the presentation and the recording of the event will be made available on the website at  
https://www.titancompany.in/investors/investor-day/ 
 
  For registration & any queries, please contact the Titan Investor Relations Team via email at  
investor-relations@titan.co.in
